name: safebite-root
description: Orchestration scripts for the SafeBite PWA (web/ + functions/). Never deploys.

scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix functions run typecheck && npm --prefix web run typecheck
scripts.build: npm --prefix functions run build && npm --prefix web run build
scripts.emu:start: npm --prefix functions run build && FUNCTIONS_DISCOVERY_TIMEOUT=90 firebase emulators:start --only auth,firestore,functions --project demo-safebite
scripts.emu:test: npm --prefix functions run build && FUNCTIONS_DISCOVERY_TIMEOUT=90 firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore,functions --project demo-safebite "npm --prefix functions test"
scripts.emu:e2e: npm --prefix functions run build && FUNCTIONS_DISCOVERY_TIMEOUT=90 firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore,functions --project demo-safebite "node functions/lib/seed-emulator.js && npm --prefix web run e2e"
scripts.emu:e2e:stress: npm --prefix functions run build && FUNCTIONS_DISCOVERY_TIMEOUT=90 firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore,functions --project demo-safebite "node functions/lib/seed-emulator.js && npm --prefix web run e2e -- --repeat-each=3 --retries=0"
